shell.drawerDescription: Links to the pages of the app.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: Changes cannot be saved until your connection is back.

section.title: Your profile
section.description: How you appear to other members, and the language of the app.

email.label: Email
email.description: The address you sign in with.

language.label: Language
language.description: The language of the app and of the emails we send you.

loadFailed.title: Your profile could not be loaded
loadFailed.description: Try again. If this continues, tell your administrator.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: How the app looks and how bookmark lists open.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: System follows the setting of your device.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.description: Colours buttons, switches and the focus ring.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts that hold Ctrl or Command always work.

single.label: Single-key shortcuts
single.description: Act with one key, for example C to create a bookmark. Turn this off if keys are triggered by accident.

ai.title: AI suggestions
ai.description: This server can suggest titles, tags and folders for your bookmarks.

optOut.label: Don't use AI suggestions for me
optOut.description: No bookmark of yours is sent to the AI service.

loadFailed.title: Your preferences could not be loaded

providerFailed.title: Linking or confirming with that provider did not work. Try again.

loadFailed.title: Your security settings could not be loaded

password.title: Password
password.description: Change the password you sign in with. Your other sessions are signed out when you do.

new.label: New password
new.description: Use at least 12 characters. A long phrase works well.

password.changed: Your password was changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

error.currentWrong: The current password is not right.
error.breached: This password appeared in a known data breach. Choose another one.

password.added: Your password was added. Your other sessions were signed out.

add.title: Add a password
add.description: Add a password to sign in with your email address as well. Your other sessions are signed out when you do.
add.gained: This account already has a password. Reload the page to change it.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: The devices you are signed in on. Revoke a session you do not recognise.

loadFailed.title: Your sessions could not be loaded

current.title: Sign out of this device?
current.description: This ends the session you are using now. You will need to sign in again.

others.title: Sign out everywhere else?
others.description: Every other session of your account is signed out. This device stays signed in.

description.on: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app as well as your password.
description.off: Add a code from an authenticator app to your sign-in, so a stolen password is not enough.

enrol.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enrol.description: Pair an authenticator app with your account.

scan.title: Scan the code
scan.description: Open your authenticator app and scan this QR code.

qr.alt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app

key.description: Cannot scan it? Enter this key in your app instead.
key.label: Setup key

verify.title: Enter a code
verify.description: Type the six-digit code your app shows now, to check the pairing.

codes.title: Save your backup codes
codes.description: Each code works once, if you lose your authenticator app.
codes.note: Keep them somewhere safe. They are not shown again.
codes.label: Backup codes
codes.acknowledge: I have saved these backup codes

regenerate.title: Replace your backup codes
regenerate.description: Enter a code from your authenticator app. The codes you have now stop working.

disable.title: Turn off two-factor authentication
disable.description: Enter a code and your password. Signing in then needs your password alone.
disable.confirmDescription: Your account will be protected by its password alone, and your backup codes will stop working.

error.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Check it and try again.
error.reauthRequired: Confirm it is you to continue.
error.unavailable: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

identities.title: Linked sign-in methods
identities.description: The providers you can sign in with. You always keep at least one way to sign in.
identities.none: No provider is linked to your account.

loadFailed.title: Your linked sign-in methods could not be loaded

lastMethod.title: This is your only way to sign in
lastMethod.description: Add a password or link another provider first, then unlink this one.

error.refused: This sign-in method could not be unlinked.

confirm.title: Unlink {provider}?
confirm.description: You will no longer be able to sign in with {provider}. At least one way to sign in must remain, so this works only while your account has a password or another linked provider.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Tokens let scripts and integrations act as you in one workspace, without your password.

loadFailed.title: Your API tokens could not be loaded

empty.title: No tokens yet
empty.description: Create one to authenticate scripts or integrations.

confirm.title: Revoke {name}?
confirm.description: Anything that uses the token {name} stops working at once. This cannot be undone.

create.title: New API token
create.description: A token acts in one workspace, with the scope you choose.

name.label: Name
name.description: Something to recognise it by, such as the script that uses it.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Read can only look at things. Read and write can change them too.

result.title: Copy your token
result.description: This is the only time the token is shown.
result.note: Keep it somewhere safe, like a password manager. It is not shown again.
result.label: API token

error.limitReached: You have reached the limit of 10 tokens. Revoke one you no longer use to create another.
error.nameTaken: You already have a token with this name. Choose another name.
error.reauthRequired: Confirm it is you to continue.
error.unavailable: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

configFailure.title: The app could not be loaded
configFailure.description: The settings of this server could not be read. Reload the page, and tell your administrator if this continues.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

forbidden.title: You don't have access
forbidden.description: You are not a member of this workspace, or this page is only for administrators.

serverError.title: Something went wrong
serverError.description: This page could not be shown. Reload it, and tell your administrator if this continues.

mutationFailed.title: The change was not saved
mutationFailed.description: Try again. If this continues, tell your administrator.
mutationFailed.offline: You are offline. Check your connection and try again.

error.credentials: The email address or the password is wrong.
error.invalid: Check your entries and try again.
error.unavailable: Signing in is not possible right now. Try again in a moment.

rateLimited.unknown: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again later.
rateLimited.seconds: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
rateLimited.minutes: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

error.oidcFailed: Signing in with that provider did not work. Try again, or sign in with your email address and password.

loginMfa.title: Two-step verification
loginMfa.description: Enter a code to finish signing in.

error.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Check it and try again.
error.unavailable: The code could not be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
error.backUnavailable: Going back to sign in did not work. Try again.

failed.title: You are still signed in
failed.description: Signing out did not work. Try again.

reauth.title: Confirm it is you
reauth.description: This change needs your password again.

error.unavailable: The password could not be checked right now. Try again in a moment.

rateLimited.unknown: Too many attempts. Try again later.
rateLimited.seconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
rateLimited.minutes: Too many attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

provider.description: This change needs you to confirm it is you with your sign-in provider.
provider.none: No sign-in provider is available to confirm it is you. Ask your administrator.

setup.title: Set up {name}
setup.description: Create the first account and workspace of this server.

token.title: Setup token
token.description: Proves that you run this server.
token.note: The server printed the setup token to its log when it started. Copy the latest one from there.
token.label: Setup token
token.wrong: The setup token is missing or wrong. Copy the latest one from the server log.

account.title: Your account
account.description: This account becomes the administrator of the server.

password.label: Password
password.description: Use at least 12 characters. A long phrase works well.
password.breached: This password appears in a list of breached passwords. Choose a different one.

workspace.title: Your first workspace
workspace.description: A workspace holds your bookmarks. You can add more later.

name.label: Workspace name
name.description: For example your name or your team.
name.required: Enter a name for the workspace.

error.completed: Setup was already completed on this server. Sign in with your account instead.
error.invalid: Check your entries and try again.
error.unavailable: Setup is not possible right now. Try again in a moment.

rateLimited.unknown: Too many setup attempts. Try again later.
rateLimited.seconds: Too many setup attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
rateLimited.minutes: Too many setup attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

done.title: You are all set
done.description: Your account and your first workspace are ready, and you are signed in.

mfa.title: Protect your account with two-factor authentication
mfa.description: This account administers the server. Turn on two-factor authentication in the security settings.
